verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Gazebo simulation tutorials (ros2-docs-16) and general CLI/dev tooling, but nothing about automated test frameworks (e.g., launch_testing, colcon test), CI pipeline integration, or simulation-based regression testing workflows. Missing for 10: evidence of ROS 2 test frameworks (launch_testing, ament tests), CI/CD pipeline examples, and simulation regression test tooling/documentation.
